CustomField.description: Odoo product.product ID (one per variant). Match key for product.upsert from Odoo; when set, Odoo owns the product's catalogue fields.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Odoo product variant ID. Set by the Odoo product sync; Odoo is the master for name, SKU, description, family, active, cost and corporate-currency price.
CustomField.label: Odoo Product ID
